scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w shared && npm run test:unit -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w shared && npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint:types && npm run lint:eslint
scripts.lint:types: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.deploy:internet: cp deploy/env/.env.internet.example deploy/env/.env.runtime && cp deploy/caddy/Caddyfile.internet deploy/caddy/Caddyfile.active
scripts.deploy:lan: cp deploy/env/.env.lan.example deploy/env/.env.runtime && cp deploy/caddy/Caddyfile.lan deploy/caddy/Caddyfile.active
scripts.deploy:lan:event: cp deploy/env/.env.lan.event.example deploy/env/.env.runtime && cp deploy/caddy/Caddyfile.lan.event deploy/caddy/Caddyfile.active
